# Ball Knower

Official website: https://ballknowerofficial.com/

Ball Knower is a football app focused on fantasy football and proving football knowledge. It includes fantasy football leagues, NFL picks, football trivia, rankings, projections, research tools, and solo football modes.

## Official pages
- About Ball Knower: https://ballknowerofficial.com/about-ball-knower.html
- Fantasy Football: https://ballknowerofficial.com/fantasy-football.html
- NFL Picks: https://ballknowerofficial.com/nfl-picks.html
- NFL Trivia: https://ballknowerofficial.com/nfl-trivia.html

## Brand identification
- Product name: Ball Knower
- Alternate description: Ball Knower Fantasy Football
- Official domain: ballknowerofficial.com
- Category: Sports / Fantasy Football

Ball Knower is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the NFL or any NFL team.
